items.title: 김민준의 최근 3개월 주문 내역 보여줘
items.question: 김민준의 최근 3개월 주문 내역 보여줘
items.sql:
SELECT o.CUST_ID AS 고객ID, cu.CUST_NAME AS 고객명, o.ORDER_DATE AS 주문일, sc.CD_NAME AS 상태, ch.CD_NAME AS 채널,
       SUM(i.AMOUNT) AS 주문금액
FROM TB_ORDER o
JOIN TB_CUSTOMER cu ON o.CUST_ID = cu.CUST_ID
JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM i ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
JOIN TB_CODE sc ON sc.GRP_CD = 'ORDER_STATUS' AND sc.CD = o.STATUS
JOIN TB_CODE ch ON ch.GRP_CD = 'CHANNEL' AND ch.CD = o.CHANNEL
WHERE o.CUST_ID IN ('C0001','C0002')
  AND o.ORDER_DATE >= date('now', '-3 months')
GROUP BY o.ORDER_ID, o.CUST_ID, cu.CUST_NAME, o.ORDER_DATE, sc.CD_NAME, ch.CD_NAME
ORDER BY o.ORDER_DATE DESC
LIMIT 100

items.title: 뷰티의 카테고리 매출이 요즘 늘고 있는지 월별로 보여줘
items.question: 뷰티의 카테고리 매출이 요즘 늘고 있는지 월별로 보여줘
items.sql:
SELECT
  YM AS 월,
  CATEGORY_CD AS 카테고리코드,
  CATEGORY_NAME AS 카테고리,
  ORDER_CNT AS 주문수,
  QTY AS 판매수량,
  SALES_AMT AS 매출액
FROM (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.ORDER_DATE) AS YM,
    p.CATEGORY_CD,
    c.CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_CNT,
    SUM(i.QTY) AS QTY,
    SUM(i.AMOUNT) AS SALES_AMT
  FROM TB_ORDER AS o
  JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM AS i
    ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
  JOIN TB_PRODUCT AS p
    ON i.PROD_ID = p.PROD_ID
  JOIN TB_CATEGORY AS c
    ON p.CATEGORY_CD = c.CATEGORY_CD
  WHERE
    NOT o.STATUS IN ('04', '05')
  GROUP BY
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.ORDER_DATE),
    p.CATEGORY_CD,
    c.CATEGORY_NAME
) AS VV_SALES_MONTHLY
ORDER BY
  카테고리,
  월

items.title: 최근 3개월 카테고리별 매출 비중 보여줘
items.question: 최근 3개월 카테고리별 매출 비중 보여줘
items.sql:
SELECT
  CATEGORY_CD AS 카테고리코드,
  CATEGORY_NAME AS 카테고리,
  SUM(SALES_AMT) AS 매출액,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(SALES_AMT) / SUM(SUM(SALES_AMT)) OVER (), 1) AS 매출비중
FROM (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.ORDER_DATE) AS YM,
    p.CATEGORY_CD,
    c.CATEGORY_NAME,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_CNT,
    SUM(i.QTY) AS QTY,
    SUM(i.AMOUNT) AS SALES_AMT
  FROM TB_ORDER AS o
  JOIN TB_ORDER_ITEM AS i
    ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
  JOIN TB_PRODUCT AS p
    ON i.PROD_ID = p.PROD_ID
  JOIN TB_CATEGORY AS c
    ON p.CATEGORY_CD = c.CATEGORY_CD
  WHERE
    NOT o.STATUS IN ('04', '05')
  GROUP BY
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.ORDER_DATE),
    p.CATEGORY_CD,
    c.CATEGORY_NAME
) AS VV_SALES_MONTHLY
WHERE
  YM >= STRFTIME('%Y-%m', DATE('now', '-3 months'))
GROUP BY
  CATEGORY_CD,
  CATEGORY_NAME
ORDER BY
  매출액 DESC
